scope: Group 2 development source integrity; synthetic checks only

tests.scope: New source integrity and new task-bound persistence/backup/export checks only; repeated task test only after Core safety integration.

limitations: Git object source integrity checks; not signed release or production authority attestation.
Node/OS/external dependencies, host, loaded memory and Git credentials outside manifest scope.
No new deployment, account assessment or independent assessor receipt.
Existing working-preview API rejects caller revision without matching independently verified checkout; historical arbitrary revision tests require scoped update.

New task receipts bind startup/before/after source plus output; historical missing receipts remain false. A worksheet can independently validate receipts against the same exact checkout; other historical revisions require separate pinned source readback.
Export SHA and source manifest prove byte linkage; they do not authenticate an arbitrary external export origin.

taskReceiptBindingsVerified checks structural/source/output linkage only. taskExecutionRevisionVerified remains false without independent authenticated DB readback. Export workspace and owner/subject equality are mandatory for claimed bound receipts.
